item.text: {"0":"Add a jointly trained residual bilinear scorer s(h,e)=hᵀ(I+W)e, initializing W=0 and preserving existing score scaling and history readout. Reduce the incumbent peak learning rate to 0.7× while retaining its 5% warmup and cosine decay. Bilinear compatibility can learn cross-dimension interest–item relationships; the lower learning rate should stabilize their joint adaptation with the Transformer. Preserve backbone topology, features, loss, optimizer type, seeds, epoch cap 200, splits and routing. Train and load exactly one model per category across all four datasets; update the predictor writer for W."}
